curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can a hard-nosed gunnery sergeant whip an unruly platoon into shape while fighting battles on every front, including his own past?
curatedMovie.description: In Clint Eastwood's military drama, a hard-nosed Marine gunnery sergeant contends with fractious superiors and his ex-wife while taking charge of an undisciplined recon platoon.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Grounded military drama balancing steady tension, personal friction, and classic command conflict.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Clint Eastwood, this measured military drama grounds its platoon friction in stubborn personal history and hard-earned discipline.
